title: Hardware Issues Protocol (Power/Charging)
content: If a user reports a laptop not turning on or not charging, the agent MUST ask for the laptop type (e.g., 'Mac or Lenovo?'). IF LENOVO: Suggest performing a power drain and provide this link: https://pcsupport.lenovo.com/us/en/products/laptops-and-netbooks/thinkpad-edge-laptops/thinkpad-e590-type-20nb-20nc/solutions/ht510410-troubleshooting-no-power-issues. THEN provide the warranty check link: https://pcsupport.lenovo.com/us/en/warranty-lookup#/ and instruct the user to check the serial number on the back. Ask: 'Is the laptop in warranty?' IF YES (In Warranty): Suggest opening a Lenovo support ticket: https://redhathub.service-now.com/hub?id=kb_article_view&sysparm_article=KB0001173 . IF NO (Out of Warranty): Suggest a laptop refresh: https://redhat.service-now.com/help?id=sc_cat_item&sys_id=32d3e91ab852310077ed3a6cb584d9df&sc_catalog=e0d08b13c3330100c8b837659bba8fb4 . IF NO (User cannot wait for refresh): Suggest a loaner laptop: https://redhathub.service-now.com/hub?id=kb_article_view&sysparm_article=KB0007576

title: Hardware Issues Protocol (Boot/Login Errors)
content:
If a user reports hardware issues, boot failure, or inability to login to desktop, the agent MUST ask: 'What specific error message do you see?' (unless they already provided it). 

1. IF ERROR is 'Disk does not exist' or 'entering emergency mode': State that this indicates a wrong LUKS password. Solution: Reboot and try another password. If that fails, they must contact IT to reset the LUKS password using the Global IT Support Emergency Voicemail Numbers: https://source.redhat.com/departments/it/itx/it_global_enterprise_support/it_global_enterprise_support_wiki/global_it_support_emergency_voicemail_numbers_faq#jive_content_id_Emergency_Voicemail_Numbers_by_Country

2. IF ERROR is 'YAD': State that this often indicates a network failure. Solution: Connect to a physical network cable (LAN), reboot, and try the setup again. If that fails, reimage the laptop: https://redhathub.service-now.com/hub?id=kb_article&sysparm_article=KB0021078

3. IF ERROR is 'Error: 2100 Detection error on Storage Device m.2': Direct them to these troubleshooting steps: https://forums.lenovo.com/t5/ThinkPad-P-and-W-Series-Mobile-Workstations/Help-with-2100-Detection-Error-on-Storage-Device0-M-2/m-p/5274640?page=1#6515297. If that doesn't work, check warranty (https://pcsupport.lenovo.com/us/en/warranty-lookup#/) and open a Lenovo ticket (with link) or ask for refresh if not under warranty.

4. IF ERROR is not in the documents: Ask the user: 'Do you see any of the following specific errors: YAD, Disk does not exist, Entering emergency mode, or Error 2100?'
